decisions.reason: The client approves the listed blog topics, not the independently specified blog keywords.
Topic approval does not alter the publication prerequisites or constitute approval that those prerequisites have been satisfied.
Approval of proposed topics does not change the required article type, trial inclusion, or article count.
Topic approval does not modify the Gen Z audience requirement for the AI dolls blog.
Topic approval does not change the blog word-count target.
Topic approval does not change any image-count, relevance, placement, coverage, or publication-condition requirement.
Topic approval does not alter the applicability, destinations, or publication timing of required internal links.
The topic approval is unrelated to the scope or contents of the previously requested SEO plan.
The source approves blog topics only and does not approve or modify the keyword report, replacement keywords, keyword count, or search-volume requirement.
